title: Government Support for Full-time Sportsmen After Sports
what_it_is: Government Support for Full-time Sportsmen After Sports

sections.label: Singapore Sports Institute athlete support
sections.summary: The SSI supports Team Singapore athletes with grants, training, sports medicine and career development through the spexBusiness Network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Singapore Sports Institute (SSI) seeks to provide comprehensive support to our Team Singapore athletes, through financial grants, training and coaching, sports medicine, as well as opportunities to prepare for a career after they retire from high performance sports.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To prepare our athletes early for a career after sports, SSI works closely with corporate partners under the spexBusiness Network to offer our athletes career development opportunities, ranging from internships and apprenticeships, part-time positions to permanent positions with flexible work arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: More than 150 Team Singapore athletes have benefited since its inception in 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Today, the spexBusiness Network comprises more than 50 companies across 25 industries.

sections.label: Athlete education and skills training
sections.summary: Structured programmes let athletes pursue education and sports skills training, with more coaching training opportunities being considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Is there also a similar structured process, or a Professional Conversion Programme (PCP) that allows them to take up these positions within MOE or in terms of promoting the different interest groups?

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: There have been structured programmes to allow our athletes to pursue education as well as skills training in the area of sports, including coaching, sports facilities management and so on.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: And we are looking at increasing the training opportunities for coaching while they are in the sports as well.

sections.label: Enlarged sports ecosystem opportunities
sections.summary: The ecosystem has been enlarged through investment in development and high performance sports, with opportunities in sports facilities and gyms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As I had mentioned in my reply earlier, the ecosystem has been enlarged; we have been investing in development as well as in high performance sports over the years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Also, there are other opportunities, such as in the management of sports facilities, gyms and so on.

sections.label: Support for non-sports careers
sections.summary: Athletes moving to non-sports areas could be supported with part-time or full-time internships and apprenticeships in their areas of interest.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Some of them may like to move on to other non-sports areas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We would like to see how we can support them better, including allowing them to have part-time, full-time internship, apprenticeship in the area that they are interested in.
